condition: mastraDocs must not list an existing directory outside docsBaseDir through findNearestDirectory after readMdxContent rejects a traversal path
prerequisites: A caller supplies a parent traversal whose resolved directory exists outside docsBaseDir and does not share its string prefix; ordinary directories without symlinks or concurrent replacement.
The documentation tool is registered and its preliminary available-path computation succeeds.
safe: An ordinary existing documentation child path inside docsBaseDir may be read/listed; this is not an out-of-bound directory disclosure
review: The tool forwards caller paths to readMdxContent, then falls back to findNearestDirectory on found=false. listDirContents reaches fs.readdir. The upstream fix propagates isSecurityViolation and returns before fallback. This label excludes colliding-prefix and symlink conditions, which this patch does not establish as fixed.
safe_prerequisites: Existing registered documentation tool; existing ordinary documentation child path; no symlinks, prefix collision or concurrent replacement.
